notes: LPDDR5 SDRAM exposes a Mode Register space addressed by a 7-bit Mode Register address MA[6:0] and written/read 8 bits of OP[7:0] data at a time via Mode Register Write (MRW, two CA cycles) and Mode Register Read (MRR) commands carried on the 7-bit CA bus. There is no memory-mapped offset; each mode register is selected by MA[6:0] during the MRW/MRR command. All mode-register accesses must be issued with the device in the appropriate idle state and the relevant mode-register timing (tMRW / tMRD / tMRR) satisfied. Mode registers are volatile and must be re-programmed after each power cycle / reset. The exact MR0..MR127 field assignments are defined in JESD209-5; the entries below summarize the key functional mode registers a controller must program.

register_addressing.write_command: MRW (Mode Register Write) — MRW-1 carries MA[6:0], MRW-2 carries OP[7:0] data.
register_addressing.read_command: MRR (Mode Register Read) — returns OP[7:0] of the addressed mode register on the DQ bus.

registers.name: MR (Device Info / Manufacturer)
registers.long_name: Device feature / revision / manufacturer ID mode registers (read-only)

fields.name: Manufacturer ID
fields.description: JEP106 vendor identifier of the LPDDR5 die.

fields.name: Revision ID
fields.description: Die revision / stepping.

fields.name: Density / type
fields.description: Per-channel density, I/O width, and device type (LPDDR5).

registers.name: MR (Read/Write Latency & Bank mode)
registers.long_name: Operating mode register — Read Latency / Write Latency / bank organization / burst settings

fields.name: Read Latency (RL)
fields.description: Programmed read latency in WCK / CK cycles for the selected data rate / Set.

fields.name: Write Latency (WL)
fields.description: Programmed write latency; Set A / Set B selectable.

fields.name: Bank organization
fields.description: Bank-group mode (16 banks / 4 BG), 16-bank mode, or 8-bank mode select.

fields.name: Burst length / WLS
fields.description: BL16 default; BL32 double-length; write-latency set select.

registers.name: MR (WCK / Clocking)
registers.long_name: WCK mode register — WCK frequency ratio, WCK2CK sync, WCK always-on

fields.name: WCK ratio
fields.description: WCK:CK ratio (WCK runs at 4x CK; ratio selection per data-rate Set).

fields.name: WCK2CK leveling
fields.description: Controls WCK-to-CK leveling / sync behaviour used by WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR.

fields.name: WCK always-on
fields.description: Optional continuous WCK vs on-demand WCK enable.

registers.name: MR (DVFS / DVFSC)
registers.long_name: Dynamic Voltage / Frequency Scaling mode register

fields.name: FSP (Frequency Set Point)
fields.description: Selects the active frequency set point (FSP-OP / FSP-WR) used for RL/WL/ODT/Vref.

fields.name: DVFSC enable
fields.description: Enables Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling Core (VDD2H/VDD2L selection).

fields.name: DVFSQ enable
fields.description: Enables DQ-domain voltage scaling.

fields.name: Refresh mode
fields.description: All-bank (REFab) vs per-bank (REFpb) refresh configuration.

fields.name: RFM enable
fields.description: Adaptive Refresh Management (RFM) — added in JESD209-5B for Rowhammer reliability.

fields.name: Refresh rate
fields.description: Temperature-dependent refresh rate (normal / extended / low-temperature ranges).

registers.name: MR (Link ECC / DBI)
registers.long_name: Link ECC and Data Bus Inversion control mode register

fields.name: Read Link ECC enable
fields.description: Enables 16-bit read-direction link ECC (single-bit correction on the wire).

fields.name: Write Link ECC enable
fields.description: Enables write-direction link ECC.

fields.name: DBI-RD / DBI-WR
fields.description: Read / write Data Bus Inversion enable on the DMI lines.

registers.name: MR (Drive strength / ODT / Vref)
registers.long_name: I/O configuration mode register — output driver impedance, ODT, Vref(ca) / Vref(dq)

fields.name: Output driver impedance
fields.description: Selects DQ / DMI / WCK output driver impedance (PU/PD).

fields.name: ODT
fields.description: On-die termination value for DQ / WCK / RDQS / CA.

fields.name: Vref(ca) / Vref(dq)
fields.description: Reference voltage trim for CA and DQ inputs, per frequency set point.

fields.name: Deep Sleep enable (DSE)
fields.description: Selects deep sleep mode behaviour on self-refresh entry.

fields.name: PASR
fields.description: Partial Array Self-Refresh bank/segment mask.

fields.name: Power-down options
fields.description: Active / precharge power-down behaviour (entered via CA command, bounded by CS).

wck2ck_sync_options.meaning: Free-Start — start WCK immediately, may precede multiple reads/writes.
Read-optimized — optimize WCK timing for an immediately following read.
Write-optimized — optimize WCK timing for an immediately following write.

write_x_options.meaning: Fill burst with all-zeros without transferring data.
Fill burst with all-ones without transferring data.

bank_modes.meaning: 16 banks, 4 bank groups × 4 banks; tCCD_L/tRRD_L same-group spacing.
